test_title: PYST 44: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held on 9 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table. Some of them are sitting at the corners while some are sitting at the exact centre of the sides.

G sits second to the right of F. B sits second to the right of A. C sits third to the right of H. E sits third to the right of F. C is not the immediate neighbour of A. Who sits second to the right of B?
solution:
**Explanation:**

From the given information:

Step 1: G sits second to the right of F. E sits third to the right of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f3fc5384925af0d2b478268e325789ad6d9e31b5289a4096d5f0a3a55537257.png] 

Step 2: C sits third to the right of H. B sits second to the right of A. C is not the immediate neighbour of A. 

Now we place H such that C can be placed at its third right and is not a neighbour of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13de5749f0405170fc515ab7876b48f39448f95c9519d4068a86e1ed18e9d8be.png] 

Step 3: We place D at the only spot left.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/48bc7ab1eb670683ebb7fefa9c394e046eb7858cf15dcbf237a27e8cf323434e.png] 

From the arrangement, **C sits second to the right of B.**

**Hence the correct answer is option 2.**
